title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 103
paragraphs: So they fought at that time; and after the battle the Athenians abandoned the Ionians, and when Aristagoras urgently called upon them by messengers for help, they said they would not help him. The Ionians, however, though deprived of the Athenian alliance, no less continued to prepare for the war with the king, so great were the offenses they had already committed against Darius. They also sailed to the Hellespont and brought under their power Byzantium and all the other cities there; and then having sailed out of the Hellespont, they gained in addition most of Caria as an ally—for even Caunus, which before had been unwilling to be their ally, now, after they had burned Sardis, was added to them too.
